candidate_relations.reason: The cytotoxic alpha-beta T-cell infiltrate in adipose lobules supports SPTCL, while marrow findings, cytopenias, fever, and marked hyperferritinemia support HLH. The candidate captures only the lymphoma family and location, not the full composite diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad T-cell lymphoma designation with peritoneal involvement; omits the SPTCL subtype and associated HLH.
